questions.text: Gauri said that she can play the keyboard __________ her sister.
questions.solution:
The correct comparison phrase is "as well as" (as + adverb + as). "As better as", "as nicest as" and "as worse as" are ungrammatical.

Answer: as well as

questions.text: A transparent square sheet shown above is folded along the dotted line. The folded sheet will look like ___________
questions.solution:
The sheet is transparent, so folding the left half over the dotted line puts the mirror image of the left drawing on top of the right half.

The rising curve on the left reflects into a falling curve that meets the existing curve at the fold, making a closed lens. The two small vertical ticks on the left reflect and join the two horizontal dashes, giving the step-shaped marks inside the lens. Only option B shows this.

Answer: B

questions.text: If [latex]\theta[/latex] is the angle, in degrees, between the longest diagonal of the cube and any one of the edges of the cube, then, [latex]\cos \theta =[/latex]
questions.solution:
For a cube of side a, the long diagonal is (a, a, a) with length [latex]a\sqrt3[/latex]. An edge along the x-axis is (a, 0, 0).

[latex]\cos\theta=\frac{a\cdot a}{a\cdot a\sqrt3}=\frac{1}{\sqrt3}[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\frac{1}{\sqrt3}[/latex]

questions.text: If [latex]\left( x - \dfrac{1}{2} \right)^2 - \left( x- \dfrac{3}{2} \right) ^2 = x+2[/latex], then the value of [latex]x[/latex] is:
questions.solution:
Difference of squares: [latex](x-\tfrac12)^2-(x-\tfrac32)^2=\left[(x-\tfrac12)-(x-\tfrac32)\right]\left[(x-\tfrac12)+(x-\tfrac32)\right]=1\cdot(2x-2)[/latex]

[latex]2x-2=x+2\Rightarrow x=4[/latex]

Answer: 4

questions.text:
Pen : Write :: Knife : _______

Which one of the following options maintains a similar logical relation in the above?
questions.solution:
A pen is used to write; a knife is used to cut (tool : its function).

Answer: Cut
